profile.headline: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer | Remote Consultant | Mentor | Full-Stack Developer
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer 2 and Team Lead

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer 2 and Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led a team of developers in a fast-paced consultancy environment, balancing multiple clients, projects, and deadlines while delivering high-quality results within budget.
- Worked entirely remotely, maintaining seamless collaboration across distributed teams and clients using industry-standard tools.
- Improved legacy applications by addressing technical debt, optimizing performance, and implementing refactor strategies.
- Delivered high-quality, test-driven Ruby on Rails applications and scalable APIs tailored to client needs.
- Mentored internal and client engineering teams on agile processes, technical skills, and team culture.
- Spearheaded the development of microservices to optimize business functions and API integrations.
positions.insights: Ruby, Ruby on Rails and +1 skill

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented test-driven features for advertising campaign management systems using Ruby on Rails and JavaScript frameworks.
- Aided in transitioning the team to a Docker-based development environment, streamlining deployment workflows and improving team efficiency.
- Built scalable reporting tools using internal and external APIs, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver engaging, user-friendly products within tight deadlines.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Contributed to the development, implementation, and maintenance of complex software solutions for wireless devices in the Mobile, IoT, and Automotive industry, leveraging a wide range of tools and technologies including Java, Velocity, Spring Tool Suite, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, PrototypeJS, SQL, Subversion, Groovy and Grails, and JUnit Tests.
•	Participated in an Agile team environment, collaborating with cross-functional team members, attending daily standups, and working in 2-week sprints organized through Jira assignments.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Hava is a startup company that developed a tool to help its customers visually map and manage infrastructures of their AWS. As an intern, I mainly work with HTML/CSS, Ruby on Rails, and APIs to build out functionalities of their product.

volunteerExperiences.description: Girl Develop It is a nonprofit organization that exists to provide affordable and judgment-free opportunities for women interested in learning web and software development. Through in-person classes and community support, Girl Develop It helps women of diverse backgrounds achieve their technology goals and build confidence in their careers and their every day lives.

I am one of the organizers for RailsCampWest 2016! (west.railscamp.us) Rails Camp is a friendly, welcoming, informal retreat to improve skills and build connections with others, for developers of all levels of experience. While there will be a general focus on Ruby (and Rails) developers, attendees of all technical backgrounds are welcomed and encouraged to join.

projects.title: Blog
projects.description: CRUD app for blogging which is still a work in progress. I plan to rebuild my personal website, using this as my primary blogging platform. New website code can be found at: https://github.com/ShanaLMoore/bio

projects.title: Girl Develop It San Diego
projects.description: Inspired by Girl Develop It, a non-profit org who teaches women how to code via affordable in-person classes, I created this app for my local chapter. The main website is great, but it doesn't feature all of the events we have going on, such as the job board and book club. So I built an app to do so, with an responsive Angular frontend and a Rails backend.
